Humanoids.text:
WHAT: General purpose humanoid robots 
CATEGORY: Robotics 
CAPABILITIES: Perform everyday tasks autonomously, interact with complex and unstructured real-world environments 
FEATURES: Electromechanical design, hands, screen for face 
USERS: Humans in various industries, households, and space exploration 
MARKETS: Manufacturing, shipping and logistics, warehousing, retail, consumer households, space exploration 
INTEGRATIONS: Integration with human environment 
PRICING: Aiming to reduce individual humanoid unit costs through high-rate volume manufacturing 
STAGE: In development, prototyping 
LIMITATIONS: Currently unable to perform tasks such as unloading the dishwasher 
NOTE: Designed to adhere to industry standards and corporate requirements for safety
